posts.name: ARUN DUTTA
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir/Madam,
What are the differences of SC VM based OPPE from other portal based OPPE?

We have to open G-meet from mobile only? Or laptop also?

Will there be any Exam Link for Laptop from where we should give access our Full screen sharing and Front camera (like other portal based OPPE).?

Or We have to just open our Power Shell and paste our SSh Private Key and start exam.

From mobile we have to open G-meet…that I understand.

What we have to do from our Laptop?

Please guide sir/mam.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Same as other oppes. Login from phone. Open exam portal in laptop and give permissions, do proctor verification, then answer a few questions on COC etc. Then move to terminal

posts.name: Pranav Kanala
posts.cooked: Sorry, it’s been a while since I attended an OPPE - but do we also need to join a gmeet on our laptops?
